concept: a leopard-thing that stalks the canopy and drops on stragglers from above
a brass bull construct that charges through market stalls
a recluse who calls lightning down on trespassers from a mile away
a mountain of troll-flesh that knits shut around the axes left in it
a stone shrine-guardian bound to the high priest it was made to protect
a swarm of funeral bells that ring themselves over the dying
an adult storm dragon whose breath is a rolling wall of thunder
a gutter assassin that hides between lantern-flickers
a vault that grew a hunger — the strongroom itself is the mimic
a cliff troll that shears slabs off the rockface and hurls them at climbers
